name: vt-w1
prompt:

        pause
        exit /b 1

name: vt-w4
prompt: In download_vosk_models.py change `show_progress` so it also works when stdout is redirected to a file or pipe. When `sys.stdout.isatty()` is true keep the existing `\r` progress bar exactly as it is. When it is false, instead print (with print(), ending in a newline, no `\r`) one line like `{percent:.0f}% ({downloaded_mb:.1f}/{total_mb:.1f} MB)` only when the 10-percent step changed: compute `prev = max(0, (block_num - 1) * block_size)`, `prev_percent = min(100, prev / total_size * 100) if total_size > 0 else 0`, and print when `block_num == 0` or `int(percent // 10) != int(prev_percent // 10)`. Put the non-tty branch first with an early `return`, after the `percent`, `downloaded_mb` and `total_mb` values are computed. One SEARCH/REPLACE block.
